verification_commands.ac4:
set -u
F=docs/criteria/scoring_map/telemetry.md
test -f "$F" || { echo "ac4 RED: $F missing - the card's only deliverable"; exit 1; }
H2=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md | grep -cE "^## [^#]")
T=$(tr -d '\r' < README.md | wc -l | tr -d " ")
echo "ac4 evidence: README as found lines=$T h2=$H2"
case "$H2" in 17|18) : ;; *) echo "ac4 RED: README carries $H2 level-2 headings - t115 writes zero README bytes; if the count moved the merge window is entangled"; exit 1 ;; esac
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CH=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- README.md docs/state/merge_test_index.json openapi.yaml render.yaml Dockerfile docker-compose.yml backend frontend e2e ops observability incident-response .github docs/plan.md docs/backlog.md AGENTS.md docs/criteria docs/operations-and-security-report.md | grep -c .)
  [ "$CH" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: $CH tracked files changed outside t115's surface - docs/criteria/scoring_map/telemetry.md is the ONLY write surface this card owns, and observability/, incident-response/ and the six verification reports are other cards' artifacts"; git diff --name-only HEAD | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  UT=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t115[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t115_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | grep -c .)
  [ "$UT" = "0" ] || { echo "ac4 RED: untracked files appeared outside the owned surface:"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -vE '^docs/criteria/scoring_map/(process|app|delivery|telemetry)[.]md$|^docs/issues/(groom/)?t115[.]md$|^docs/state/outputs/t115_.*[.]json$|^scratch/|^build/|^docs/state/history/|node_modules' | sed 's/^/    /'; exit 1; }
  echo "ac4 evidence: zero changed tracked files and zero untracked files outside the owned surface"
fi
for sfx in process app delivery; do
  if [ -f "docs/criteria/scoring_map/$sfx.md" ]; then
    cmp -s "$F" "docs/criteria/scoring_map/$sfx.md" && { echo "ac4 RED: telemetry.md is byte-identical to $sfx.md - a duplicated record is not a verification record"; exit 1; }
  fi
done
grep -qiE "TODO|TBD|placeholder" "$F" && { echo "ac4 RED: the record carries a placeholder token - a scoring map with a TODO is a lie with extra steps"; exit 1; }
# the record may describe credentials as local defaults but must never restate a value
grep -nE "admin[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*[A-Za-z0-9]" "$F" | grep -vqiE "local|default|placeholder" && { echo "ac4 RED: the record restates a credential value - the Grafana admin pair in observability/compose.yaml is a documented local default and the record may say that, but it may not copy the value"; exit 1; }
echo "ac4 GREEN: ZERO-BYTE PURITY - telemetry.md is the only write surface; README (17 H2, $T lines), the merge index, the product tree, observability/, incident-response/, the workflows directory and the six verification reports carry zero bytes from t115; no placeholder token and no credential value"
